parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (0.9959); the capacity wall is real when training steps drop too low. Reverting to DEPTH=10. Next, I'll follow the team's successful trend of combining capacity with lower learning rates: testing MATRIX_LR=0.06 to improve convergence stability.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 (or rather, testing 0.06 after the failed depth 12 attempt) at DEPTH=10 to improve convergence stability, following the successful lower-LR trend seen by other agents.
